item.title: CVE-2026-84830 · 8.6 HIGH — OS command injection in privileged configuration handling
item.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.0.7 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-84832 · 8.6 HIGH — Unsafe deserialization in the REST interface
item.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.0.6 deserializes attacker-controlled data in a privileged REST import workflow without adequate validation. An attacker with a privileged API token can execute arbitrary commands with "nobody" privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-16458 · 5.9 MEDIUM — Timing side-channel in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption in ocrypto
